strings.Рязанская земля; Ярославский, Кашинский,: The Ryazan land; Yaroslavl, Kashin, Uglich, Tver and Oryol uyezds; the Russian North and the Northern Dvina
strings.сельцо Прилук, Городской стан Угличского: the hamlet (seltso) of Priluk, Gorodskoy stan, Uglich uyezd
strings.Назван в одной строке с Некраском Данило: Named in the same line as Nekrasko Danilov and Khalya Zalogin in the hamlet (seltso) of Priluk, Uglich uyezd.
strings.Форма «Онфилогов» в 1536/1537 году прежд: The form «Онфилогов» ["Onfilogov"] in 1536/1537 points first of all to a father or senior person named Onfilog. This Onfilog fits chronologically as a possible eponym of the Tver Onfilogovo, but a geographical or ownership link has not been proven.
strings.В документе № 3 за 1536/1537 год читаетс: Document No. 3 for 1536/1537 reads: «а непашенных дворов: в. Некраско Данилов, в. Тонкой Онфилогов, в. Халя Залогин» ["and of non-ploughing households: in the household Nekrasko Danilov, in the household Tonkoi Onfilogov, in the household Khalya Zalogin"]. The abbreviation «в.» expands to «во дворе» ["in the household"]: Tonkoi is named as the head or principal recorded person of a separate household.
strings.Тонкой — личное имя, а не характеристика: Tonkoi is a personal name, not a description in the text
strings.Тонкой — бытовое некалендарное имя или п: Tonkoi is an everyday non-calendar name or nickname. It may have referred to build, voice, agility or some other noticeable trait, but the source does not explain the motive. The modern word «тонкий» ["thin"] must not be mechanically turned into a biographical description of a specific person.
strings.В языке XVI века притяжательная форма на: In 16th-century language the possessive form in -ov usually answered the question «чей?» ["whose?"] and denoted a link to a man named Onfilog. The most natural reading is Tonkoi, son of Onfilog; more cautiously, Tonkoi of Onfilog's household or family. This is not yet necessarily a hereditary surname in the later sense.
strings.Кого запись выводит за пределы строки: Whom the record points to beyond the line
strings.Сам Онфилог в переписи не назван отдельн: Onfilog himself is not named in the census as a separate resident. His name is preserved within Tonkoi's naming, so he belongs to the previous generation and by 1536/1537 may already have died, lived separately or simply not been the head of the household. The document does not establish the fact of his death.
strings.Почему это сильный кандидат на реального: Why this is a strong candidate for a real eponym
strings.Тверское название Онфилогово требует реа: The Tver place name Onfilogovo requires a real or remembered Onfilog from whom the possessive settlement name was formed. Tonkoi proves that the rare name Onfilog was actually used in living speech in the first third of the 16th century. But he proves the existence of a suitable name, not the identity of the Uglich Onfilog with the founder of the Tver village.
strings.Тонкой помещён не среди пахотных крестья: Tonkoi is listed not among the ploughing peasant households but in a separate total of «непашенных» ["non-ploughing"] ones. This means the household was not recorded as working its own arable land. The resident may have been engaged in a craft, ferrying, fishing, trade or monastic service, but the scribe did not name a specific occupation, and one of them cannot be chosen.
strings.Прилуки — не владение Юрлова: Priluki was not a Yurlov holding
strings.Ранние акты показывают Прилуки как давню: Early acts show Priluki as a long-standing votchina (patrimonial estate) of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery. An act of about 1495–1497 concerning the Priluki clearings names the elders Nikon and Yelisey, monastery peasants and old residents; the Yurlovs and Onfilog are not mentioned there. Therefore Ivan Yurlov Menshoy's Inkovo in Uglich uyezd and the monastery's Priluki cannot be merged into one chain of ownership merely because they lie in the same uyezd.
strings.Прилуки находятся примерно в 208 км по п: Priluki lies about 208 km in a straight line from the reconstructed area of the Tver Onfilogovo. For the 16th century this does not rule out a service or family move, but it requires an intermediate document. So far there is no act of relocation, deed of purchase, donation charter or grant linking Tonkoi or his Onfilog to Nikolskoye Svechino.
strings.Поздний угличско-юхотский кластер фамили: The later Uglich–Yukhot cluster of the surname
strings.В 1851–1853 годах московские исповедные: In 1851–1853 Moscow confession registers name Yefim, Deomid and Yevgraf Anfilogov, connected with Uglich uyezd and with the peasants of Count Sheremetev. Deomid is directly named as a native of the village of Kostyurina, which lies about 52 km in a straight line from Priluki. This shows a long-term presence of the rare surname form in one region, but more than three centuries separate the records.
strings.Почему 52 километра не означают родство: Why 52 kilometres do not mean kinship
strings.Прилуки принадлежали Троице-Сергиеву мон: Priluki belonged to the Trinity-Sergius Monastery, while Kostyurina belonged to the Sheremetevs' Yukhot votchina. Different ownership systems and the absence of intermediate generations do not allow the later Anfilogovs to be declared descendants of Tonkoi or his father. Geography only suggests which census books to check next.
strings.Какие книги могут соединить поколения: Which books could connect the generations
strings.В РГИА сохранились выписи по Юхотской во: RGIA holds extracts for the Yukhot votchina for 1629–1631, 1676–1679 and 1706 — f. 1088, op. 7, d. 16 — as well as a list of census books dated by researchers to 1754 — d. 65. If Anfilogovs with patronymics and villages are found in them, it will become possible to work backwards from Deomid; for now this is an archival route, not a finished pedigree.
strings.Какой документ подтвердит личность основ: Which document would confirm the founder's identity
strings.Нужна запись, где один и тот же Онфилог: What is needed is a record in which one and the same Onfilog appears together with Tonkoi, Yurlov, Inkovo, Priluki or the Tver Nikolskoye Svechino, or a land transfer act with a formula like «Онфилогова деревня» ["Onfilog's village"]. Without such a bridge Tonkoi remains the best living evidence of the rare name, but not a found son of the Tver founder.
strings.До 1600 года имя Анфилоф/Анфилог, близки: Before 1600 the name Anfilof/Anfilog, the close forms Anfil/Onfil and derived patronymics are documented in at least seven regional settings. The northern series now includes the Anfilovskaya village of 1573 and the sheepskin-maker Anfilofy Novik Ivanov syn of 1575; the Vladimir muster roll (desyatnya) of 1596 shows on the primary scan the exact formula «Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Anfilov son of Vakin"]. This makes the model of several independent family formations more probable than the search for one common incoming founder, but the towns of origin of the seven Oryol lines have not yet been established.
strings.ИМЕНА И МЕХАНИЗМ. Реестр показывает две:
NAMES AND MECHANISM. The register shows two different stages. In the first, Anfilof, Anfilog or the close documentary forms Anfil and Onfil are the personal name of a specific man: Anfilof Selivanov, Anfilofy Ivanovich, Anfilof Moiseyevich, Anfilog Ivanovich Konstantinov, Onfilof Nesterov, Onfil Ivanov, Anfil Vakin of Vladimir and Anpilog Ivanovich Onanyin. In the second, the name becomes a dependent naming of another person: Antipa Anfilogov syn, Peshok Anfilofov syn, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Antip Anfilov syn Vakina. Hence the -ov form existed as a patronymic or family naming long before it can confidently be regarded as a hereditary surname.

THE 16TH-CENTURY INTERVAL. The Kurostrov scrolls give a dense cross-section: in 1549 Onfilof Nesterov pays together with his nephew, in the 1550s he is probably repeated as «Анфилофей Несте…» ["Anfilofey Neste…"], and in 1592 Onfil Ivanov is recorded separately. In 1596 the Vladimir muster roll adds the formula «Антип Анфилов сын Вакина» ["Antip Anfilov son of Vakin"], which on the primary scan clearly separates the patronymic Anfilov and the third naming Vakin. Nearby occur Petrok Anfilov and a long line of Anfal / Anfalov. They are kept for comparison but not mixed into the main series: A. F. Bek's reference book lists Anfalov from Aifal/Anfal separately from Anfilov from Amfilokhy or Anfim.

GEOGRAPHY. The bearers do not form a single linear path. They appear simultaneously in the Ryazan land, Yaroslavl, Kashin, Vladimir, the Russian North, the Northern Dvina and Uglich. This distribution is too wide for the assumption of one common recent ancestor. Ryazan stands out for the repetition of the name in different generations and for its proximity to the documented resettlement of servicemen to the new southern towns; the Kashin–Uglich circle for its proximity to the Tver Onfilogovo; Vladimir for a formula contemporary with Oryol but independent. None of them has yet been connected to Oryol by a personal move.

MEANING FOR THE ORYOL CORE. In Oryol in 1594/95 there already existed at least seven fathers of surname bearers: Mikula, Vasily, Persha, Timofey, Nechay, Pakhom and Terenty. At the same time, in another Oryol nest, a pomeshchik with the personal name Anpilog Onanyin is known. The most economical new model is not to look for one ready-made family that suddenly arrived in Oryol, but to examine several families in which the name Anfilog could independently have turned into a patronymic and then into a stable family naming.
strings.Найти служебные продолжения рязанских но: Find service continuations of the Ryazan bearers of the name between the 1530s and the founding of Oryol.
strings.Вернуться к Лодыгиным только при появлен: Return to the Lodygins only if a patronymic, inherited land or a direct formula of transfer between the Kashin circle and southern service appears.
strings.Искать семерых орловских отцов по полным: Search for the seven Oryol fathers by full formulas and former pomestyes, without assuming a common surname in advance.
strings.Заказать однолистные акты Архива СПбИИ Р: Order the single-sheet acts of the Archive of the St Petersburg Institute of History of the Russian Academy of Sciences (SPbII RAN), f. 5, op. 1, d. 554 and 567: check the boundaries of the Anfilovskaya village and the full formulary of Anfilofy Novik's deed of purchase.
strings.Не объединять региональные случаи без пр: Do not merge regional cases without a direct kinship or migration formula.
strings.В переписи монастырских владений 1536/15: In the 1536/1537 census of monastery holdings, Tonkoi Onfilogov was found — the head of a non-ploughing household in the hamlet (seltso) of Priluki, Uglich uyezd. His second naming preserves the real name of an Onfilog of the previous generation and is the closest-in-time living evidence of the form from which the name Onfilogovo could have arisen. However, Priluki was a long-standing votchina of the Trinity-Sergius Monastery, not an established holding of the Yurlovs; the document does not link the Uglich Onfilog to the Tver village.
strings.В одной строке перечня непашенных дворов: One line of the list of non-ploughing households names three heads of household: Nekrasko Danilov, Tonkoi Onfilogov and Khalya Zalogin. The formula does not call them landowners: the abbreviation «в.» means «во дворе» ["in the household"]. For the history of the name, the target person is Tonkoi Onfilogov. In naming of the first half of the 16th century, «Онфилогов» ["Onfilogov"] is first of all a patronymic form: Tonkoi was the son or the man of Onfilog. The record thereby attests the existence of a real Onfilog of the previous generation, but does not by itself link him to the Tver village 208 km from Priluki.
strings.Нужна цифровая копия РНБ, собр. М. П. По: A digital copy of RNB (National Library of Russia), Pogodin collection (sobr. M. P. Pogodina), No. 1846, l. 65 v., is needed.
strings.На 20 августа 2026 года рукопись № 1846: As of 20 August 2026, manuscript No. 1846 is not in the open catalogue of digitised RNB manuscripts.
strings.Публикация Каштанова даёт полный адрес и: Kashtanov's publication gives the full reference and a scholarly prepared text, but does not replace an image of the original leaf.
